title: Insulin Pump Program Balances in Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Installment Plans
content:
**Benefits verification bulletin — Insulin Pump Program balances in Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program installment plans**

**The rule.** The pump-balance adjustment adds the customer's insulin pump program balance to the plan balance: when that program bills the same coverage record, its whole patient balance is added; when it is not closed but bills another coverage record, only its patient charges are added, never more than its balance, its remittance patient responsibility staying with that payer's statement; otherwise nothing is added.

The plan balance meant is the balance of an interest-free payment plan whose monthly installment is priced on a customer's Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program enrollment.

**What is read on the Insulin Pump Program.** The customer's Insulin Pump Program record shows its status (referral received, pending authorization, active, on hold or closed) and the coverage record it bills. *Not closed* is any status other than closed. *Bills the same coverage record* means the Insulin Pump Program is not closed and bills the very coverage record the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program enrollment bills. *Its whole patient balance*, and *its balance*, is the patient balance due shown on the Insulin Pump Program; *its patient charges* are the total of the patient charges posted on its billing ledger. A customer who holds no Insulin Pump Program is treated as holding a closed one.

| Insulin Pump Program status | Coverage record it bills | What is added to the plan balance |
|---|---|---|
| not closed | the same as the CGM enrollment's | its whole patient balance |
| not closed | another coverage record | its patient charges, never more than its patient balance; its remittance patient responsibility stays with that payer's statement |
| closed | any | nothing |
| the customer holds none | — | nothing |

**Hypothetical illustrations** (invented records)

- An active Insulin Pump Program billing the same coverage record as the CGM enrollment, with a patient balance due of 410.00: 410.00 is added, remittance patient responsibility and patient charges alike.
- An Insulin Pump Program on hold that bills another coverage record, whose patient charges total 260.00 against a patient balance due of 210.00: 210.00 is added, never more than its balance; had its patient charges totalled 150.00, 150.00 would be added. The patient responsibility its payer's remittances leave stays with that payer's statement.
- A pending-authorization Insulin Pump Program billing the same coverage record: its whole patient balance is added, since pending authorization is not closed.
- A closed Insulin Pump Program, whatever coverage record it billed: nothing is added.
